labels:
Run prepares rebalance recommendations: it runs all stages, or only your selected stages. Included stages can sync holdings, request paid LLM scans and save calculated actionables. After a confirmed run including Actionables, it can queue a completion email.

Review saved run history (read-only) or choose Saved evidence and configuration → Saved output. These views do not start a run or sync. Sync Now separately requests a portfolio sync.

Manual order review begins at Place Order (India) or Final Order (US), which opens the basket review. India orders require separate basket confirmation; the US basket is for manual execution review. Run does not submit orders.
